preconditions.expression: 1 <= int(n) <= 50000 and 0 <= int(k) and 2 * int(k) <= int(n)
preconditions.description: n is a positive integer between 1 and 50000, and k is a non-negative integer such that 2k ≤ n.

postconditions.expression: len(stdout.split()) == 2 * int(n) and all(1 <= int(x) <= 2 * int(n) for x in stdout.split()) and len(set(stdout.split())) == 2 * int(n)
postconditions.description: The output is a permutation of length 2n containing distinct integers from 1 to 2n.

postconditions.expression: sum(abs(int(stdout.split()[2 * i - 1]) - int(stdout.split()[2 * i])) for i in range(1, int(n) + 1)) - abs(sum(int(stdout.split()[2 * i - 1]) - int(stdout.split()[2 * i]) for i in range(1, int(n) + 1))) == 2 * int(k)
postconditions.description: The permutation satisfies the equation: sum of absolute differences of adjacent pairs minus the absolute value of the sum of those differences equals 2k.
